research_notes: 2026-10-01 avenues: official extract, current first-party profile, historical Greens first-person narrative, ABC police profile, government council announcement, council minutes and nonprofit annual reports. No full-time duration supported.
Identify casual retail employer/dates; obtain police cadet and liaison appointment/hours/leave; resolve 1994–96 precision and any 2002 transition break.

Obtain SARC and state project-management employing departments, roles, dates/hours/leave; determine any additional nonprofit payroll employment. Identify ACSSA and National Council terms/remuneration without treating advisory participation as public-service years.

Corroborate 2013 consulting start and resolve a commercial aggregator’s March 2015 lead; obtain business entity, actual workload, breaks and 2021 cessation/continuing interests. Review primary interest registers. Resolve board dates/pay and concurrent consulting.

Follow-up 2026-10-02: HREOC 2007 report and first-person ACSSA 2008 contribution resolve unnamed state project and department; project funding date deliberately not used as Cox appointment. Our Watch appointment now 7 November 2016.

Added SWALSC program-manager 2013–2014 role from reliable business career table; December 2021 SWALSC newsletter only congratulates election and does not corroborate employment dates. Contact-aggregator August 2013–June 2014 remains a lead, not adopted.

Ombudsman 2014–2015 and 2019–2020 panel observations and ANROWS 2016 practitioner group recorded separately from employment. Senate directorship index does not prove active consulting after 2021. Next: SARC/WA Health personnel histories, SWALSC 2013–2014 annual reports, company formation and payroll/workload/leave; retail employer unresolved. Recovered source errors: legacy Ombudsman redirects, ACSSA timeout, Senate register open failure.

Follow-up 2026-10-03: Business News provides year-level Department of Health, Morrgul and UWA roles; primary WACOSS annual report fixes Noongar Family Safety management to 10 December 2018–30 June 2019, while contemporary MG Corporation and UWA material corroborate research work. A Cox interview adds the otherwise omitted Centrelink public-policy role after police service; exact dates remain unknown. September 2016 event material establishes Keeping Kids Safe Project employment but not boundaries or hours. Commercial contact-aggregator month dates and additional titles were not adopted. Remaining gaps: exact Centrelink/SARC/Health transitions, all hours/leave, 2012–2013 and 2014–2016 chronology, Morrgul/UWA contract boundaries, post-June 2019 Noongar Family Safety status, and consulting workload/cessation.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Full employer2014annual report obtained after content-size400recovery establishes SWALSC leadership-program manager contract endJune2014; title/duties refined and2013start remains secondary. Added primary-correlated AboriginalPoliceAdvisoryForum inaugural membership2018, separate from policing payroll. SocialJustice2007full-time claim refers to community project officers, not Cox’s manager job; no FTstatus assigned. UWA Pathways page Wanslea research-manager paragraph belongs to another person, not Cox. Retain Centrelink, SARC/Health transitions, consulting workload/cessation and hours gaps.
